## Names

<a id="music_song_table"></a>
### [`music_song_table`](../../../src/music_songs.asm#L7) `$E8C0-$E8C7`

*data*

Song table, 8 bytes per song: stream addresses of voice 0, 1, 2 and the instrument table address (the player uses the fixed music_instruments). Song 0 is the title tune.

- **Referred to by:** [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L80), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L84)

<a id="music_song1_voices"></a>
### [`music_song1_voices`](../../../src/music_songs.asm#L12) `$E8C8-$E8CF`

*data*

Entry of song 1 in the song table (music_set_voice_pointers reads 8 bytes per song): voice 0, 1, 2 stream pointers and the instrument table pointer. Only voice 0 ($EAB3) points to music; $EB60 and $EC14 point into the sound effect player and its tables. No code selects song 1.

- **Read by:** [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L80), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L80) (+2), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L84) (+1), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L84) (+3)

### [`music_title_voice0`](../../../src/music_songs.asm#L16) `$E8D0-$E97C`

*data*

Title tune, voice 0 (bass): VOL 12, pulse, instrument 3 legato, pulse width $0802, long lengths, tempo 2, eighth notes B2 B3 F#3 G3 ... ; 576 ticks to the end byte.

- **Read by:** [`music_fetch_voice0`](music_player.md#music_fetch_voice0) [`$E3DE`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L168) (+16)
- **Entry of:** [`music_song_table`](../tables.md#music_song_table)

### [`music_title_voice1`](../../../src/music_songs.asm#L40) `$E97D-$EA30`
